measurements.evidence_quote: Zeta potential analysis results indicate that the surface charge of 170 nm NPs is -32.8333 ± 0.3786, while that of 330 nm NPs is -24.8 ± 1.0583, both carrying negative charges(Supplementary Figure S1c). || The Zetasizer Nano ZS90 laser particle sizer (LPSA) was provided by Malvern Panalytical (Malvern, UK). || The physicochemical properties of fluorescently labeled PLA-NPs were characterized using SEM, LPSA, FTIR, FL, and LSCM.
